source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_voltage" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i voltage (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the voltage OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_voltage SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the platform-defined voltage sensor objects over SNMPv3 and verify rail identity, typed engineering units, scaling, values and threshold state against the Project-approved electrical/telemetry baseline.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on an undefined `$target`; Criteria separately require Net-SNMP retrieval of the same undefined target.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure and document the BMC SNMPv3 account/WebUI state and approve the voltage rail/object, conversion and acceptance contract. The agent can then run bounded reads, decode each typed value and compare it with the approved baseline.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact voltage object OIDs
raw-unit, scale/exponent, engineering unit and precision rules
power/operating state plus nominal values, thresholds and tolerances
SNMPv3 user/security level/authentication/privacy algorithms via protected secret injection
isolated manager ACL and time baseline
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Do not enable SNMPv3 or create/change the BMC user until the account, ACL and restore policy are approved.
Never expose authentication/privacy secrets; do not substitute v2c for the source SNMPv3 method.
Do not use the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as voltage evidence.
Bound GETNEXT/WALK to approved read-only voltage objects and preserve ASN.1 types, indexes, raw values, units and errors.
Do not interpret unitless, unmapped, stale or unsupported values as healthy; stop and escalate an unsafe rail or BMC instability without automatic retry.
Restore temporary SNMPv3 configuration through the approved path and verify BMC health.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, resolve the approved vendor MIB and run exact bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK for the voltage rail objects.
Apply only documented scale/exponent conversion, compare values and alarm state with the specified operating-state baseline and independent telemetry, and report discrepancies.
Do not operate WebUI, change accounts or power/voltage controls, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or set the final DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply and approve the MIB, rail/OID/index/type/unit/scale map, operating state, expected ranges and independent reference.
Configure and later restore the SNMPv3 account/WebUI state and approve IReasoning versus Net-SNMP coverage equivalence.
Assess any unsafe or contradictory reading and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode, a Net-SNMP demonstration OID unrelated to an identified vendor voltage object and lossy grep; it cannot identify rails, units, scaling or acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor-MIB-resolved, engineer-approved SNMPv3 voltage OIDs with bounded exact queries and full typed output; convert only with documented metadata and treat IReasoning and Net-SNMP as separate methods unless equivalence is approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT VOLTAGE OBJECT AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each tested rail to the matching MIB revision, numeric OID, type, index, unit and conversion rule; query in a declared stable operating state, compare against approved thresholds/tolerances and independent BMC sensor telemetry, then restore setup.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified board, BMC firmware, sensor topology and matching vendor MIB release.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BMC firmware, MIB module, manager and IReasoning/Net-SNMP versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor voltage-sensor MIB and board electrical/telemetry limits plus Project SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact rail identity, conversion, operating state and quantitative acceptance without replacing the original IReasoning checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Net-SNMP can provide equivalent protocol/object/value evidence when approved, but does not by itself validate IReasoning interaction; successful retrieval does not prove acceptable voltage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Rail OIDs/types/indexes, units/scaling, operating state, limits/tolerances, independent reference and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sensor rounding, update cadence and state-dependent rails can create false comparisons unless captured with timestamps and declared tolerance.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning and a platform-specific rail subset only after recording original/actual tool, reason, object/value-level equivalence, omitted rails and any unverified GUI-client coverage. A future approved client is not automatically a blocker.
expected_evidence: redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with rail-to-OID/type/index/unit/scale mapping
declared operating state and approved nominal/threshold/tolerance table
complete bounded SNMPv3 typed raw output plus decoded voltage values
timestamped comparison with independent Redfish/IPMI/WebUI telemetry and alarm state
tool-equivalence/coverage statement, unexpected logs, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure explicitly requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria switches to Net-SNMP, `$target` and voltage acceptance remain unresolved, and DeepSeek changes security to v2c plus an unrelated generic OID. The voltage-monitoring purpose remains identifiable despite these method/input conflicts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor voltage objects, conversion metadata, expected ranges, operating state and approved client are Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only sensor purpose. Once supplied, the hybrid setup and automated measurement comparison can execute safely; permanent BLOCKED would be inappropriate.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains PARTIAL/hybrid execution but rejects its v2c, generic OID and grep evidence and requires exact typed SNMPv3 rail semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because the absent MIB/OID/scaling/range contract is obtainable Project input under ED-36, not an unknowable test purpose.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the non-blocked boundary while strengthening per-rail conversion, operating-state and tool-equivalence evidence.

review_improvement: Defines a rail-specific quantitative evidence contract and prevents both transport-only and wrong-unit false PASS while preserving the original client method and Project Override boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: A raw SNMP integer is not a voltage result until its vendor object, rail index, unit and scale are known, and a decoded value is not acceptable until measured in the specified state against approved tolerances. These inputs must not be guessed, but they are normal Project readiness inputs. Manual SNMPv3 setup plus bounded automated reads therefore fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than permanent BLOCKED.
